memoryLayer.rule: Every bot writes what it learns. A bot that only consumes memory is a bot whose work dies with its session.

git.where: the ANTIGRAVITY, ai-solutions, and dream-online git repos themselves
git.why: Git is authoritative over every other layer. Markdown in git is diffable and `git log -S` can trace a false claim to the commit that invented it. When any layer below disagrees with git, git wins.

vaults.note: game-only vault, separate from the ANT/AIS vault

journals.where: per-lane STATE.md, read at session start and written at session end

nodeLedger.where: Buzz node ledger, the cross-node record read/write for every agent on every node

secretStore.rule: secrets referenced by name only — never a value in a repo file, config row, journal, or chat

recall.why: Fast cross-session recall. NEVER authoritative — it auto-injects, so a false fact re-injects forever. When it disagrees with git, git wins and the memory is FORGOTTEN, not left.

dailyRoutine.description: 5 daily Paperclip marketing/SEO/YouTube improvements (mission 2026-08-26). Executed every day; evidence -> Obsidian vault defe808dbc475855.
dailyRoutine.execution: Daily after first message, before task work: run items 1-5, append evidence to vault notes, then proceed with role tasks.

items.name: OpenViking L0/L1 preload at session start
items.how: bash .freebuff/ov-preload.sh "<task topic>" before loading any large file
items.evidence: ov find returns ranked L0/L1 locations

items.name: SEO keyword-gap + on-page audit
items.dailyStep: Audit 3 keywords from seo.keywordQueue against live pages (title/meta/H1/alt/intent); score 5-point; log to vault SEO-Audit-Log; drop worst fix to marketing-inbox PENDING

items.name: Hermes faceless short pipeline
items.dailyStep: Render ONE faceless short from newest content/yesterday-news/<date>/; 3 hook variants, best wins; validate file; drop draft+evidence PENDING; log to vault YouTube-Content-Log

items.name: Animated avatar live-stream readiness
items.dailyStep: Probe avatar renderer + audio + stream key + lifeline with real calls; log UP/DOWN/NEEDS-FIX with evidence to vault Live-Readiness-Log; if DOWN file mission issue, never stream blind

items.name: AARRR funnel metric + ICE experiment
items.dailyStep: Rotate AARRR stage; measure one metric from analytics/Supabase; write hypothesis + ICE-score; append to vault Funnel-Experiments; ICE>=7 drop PENDING

items.name: Daily skill research + context-bloat trim
items.dailyStep: find-skills {role-topic}; prove candidate with real call; record keep/reject 1 line in STATE.md; trim heartbeat to locations-only per heartbeat-template.md; sync preloaded skills

items.name: Commit session to OpenViking + recall-before-load
items.when: start and end of every session
items.how: ov find at start (recall L0/L1 before loading L2), ov session commit at end
items.evidence: ov status healthy + ov find returns results

items.name: CRM lead-gen wheel (self-hosted)
items.when: daily, rotates with the SEO/social wheel
items.how: bash crm/ops/start-crm.sh then exercise the CRM: qualify top un-qualified leads via POST /api/leads/{id}/ai-qualify, create one landing page or drip sequence, log funnel movement from /api/leads/stats/overview toward the $5k goal
items.evidence: ai-qualify response + funnel stats JSON saved to ops/marketing-inbox/

items.name: OpenViking daily knowledge sweep
items.how: bash .freebuff/ov-daily-sweep.sh — index briefings/journals/memory/vault/crm, report recall to ops/marketing-inbox/

contextOptimization.benefit: Reduces context bloat, prevents hallucinations from spam

openviking.role: L0/L1/L2 hierarchical context - heartbeats reference locations via viking:// URIs
openviking.recall: ov find '<topic>' before loading large files
openviking.commit: ov session commit / MCP remember at end of meaningful work
openviking.antiHallucination: verify against knowledge base instead of pattern-matching
